svg.title: Proposed service-provider laboratory for federated DDoS detection
svg.desc: Proposed service-provider laboratory for federated DDoS detection. (a) Six customer networks with protected services behind their CEs connect to a provider with three customer-facing PEs, two core routers, and three ingress-edge routers; six controlled attack senders share three isolated source segments with separate benign request generators. Core interconnections are schematic. (b) For each customer, simultaneous passive captures at the PE and CE ends of the same access link retain separate records from one episode; the offline comparison trains or scores one view at a time with equal per-client CPU and memory allocation and the same scheduling policy. (c) Six customer-owned FL clients exchange model parameters with a FedAvg coordinator over a separate management network. Local training uses SGD and Adam baselines; the QiML implementation remains pending. The figure is a proposed architecture, not evidence of a deployed or validated experiment.

g.text: Six controlled attack senders; three source segments
Linux / FRR routing · services behind every CE
b Paired capture for customer i
One episode · both directions · receive-only mirrors
